phase: 4aa: shipping builds without Swift's dynamic exclusivity checks (the user's decision, 2026-10-08)
decision: Asked the user (2026-10-08) with the profile's figure (~3.5-4% of the A12's main thread in swift_beginAccess/endAccess and the exclusivity TLS): 'Unchecked in shipping builds' — release builds of the app and APK drop the dynamic checks, the release test bundle keeps them
profile_before: rt4z-vs-dwarf: swift_beginAccess 2.01%, swift_endAccess 0.64%, _swift_setExclusivityTLSImpl 1.51% of the main thread (partly overlapping __emutls_get_address 3.01% and pthread_getspecific 1.57%); rt4z-demo-dwarf similar
change: native/Package.swift: NTSD_UNCHECKED_EXCLUSIVITY=1 (opt-in) adds -enforce-exclusivity=unchecked and the define NTSD_UNCHECKED_EXCLUSIVITY to the release builds of NTSDCore, NTSDRuntime, NTSDMusicDecoder, NTSDHeadless, NTSDMacPlatform, NTSDApp, NTSDAndroid and the test target; unset, nothing changes. tools/crossplatform/android_app.py sets it for the APK. OriginalExclusivityChecksTests fails if a test bundle was built with it. Static (compile-time) exclusivity diagnostics are unaffected
binaries: swift_beginAccess call sites: checked headless (4z) 3,808, unchecked headless 0, unchecked AppKit app 0; the release test bundle (built without the variable) 10,441
